scope: Read-only audit of cached upstream PromptEval sources, template files, saved feature values and experiment archive metadata.

pretrained_embedding.dependency_note: These are the upstream checkout's declared requirements. The saved feature pickle contains no encoder revision or original feature-generation environment record. The replay uses the saved feature arrays directly.
construction: For each subject, read the 100 strings in the prompt template column of its CSV and pass them unchanged to SentenceTransformer.encode.
Fit PCA with 25 components to the encoded strings for that subject.
Apply a second PCA and retain components with explained-variance ratio strictly greater than 1e-5. The saved arrays have 25 columns for every subject and model.
pretrained_embedding.external_encoder_training_overlap: The cached files do not establish the exact encoder training snapshot or whether any MMLU items appeared in external pretraining.

template_content_audit.single_shared_literal_skeleton: The following are multiple choice questions (with answers) about {topic} {question} Answers: {choices} Answer:
template_content_audit.literal_check: Removing separators, punctuation, whitespace and capitalization leaves exactly the same literal words across all rows.

feature_order_and_alignment.pretrained_dimensions_breakdown: 25 shared prompt coordinates and 14 model dummy columns, with model 0 as reference.
feature_order_and_alignment.discrete_dimensions_breakdown: 21 PCA-filtered coordinates from sep, space and op metadata, plus the same 14 model dummy columns.
feature_order_and_alignment.comparison_note: One-hot gives each joint model-prompt arm its own coefficient. The pretrained arm design pools information across models and prompts, so the one-hot comparison alone does not isolate the contribution of the encoder from model-level pooling.
